notes: Aggregate bit rate 103.1 Gb/s; per-lane signaling 25.78125 ± 100 ppm GBd. Maximum link length 10 km on SMF with KR4 FEC; bypass RS-FEC not supported. Loss budget 6.5 dB on SMF per G.652 may include up to 1 dB MPI. Unstressed receiver sensitivity at 5×10⁻⁵ BER; stressed SRS per 4WDM MSA conformance test at TP3 for 5×10⁻⁵ BER. TDP max 3 dB per lane does not include MPI penalty. Transmit OMA per lane -4 to 2.5 dBm; TxOMA @ TDP max min -2 dBm; launch power (OMA-TDP) max -5 dBm. Receiver damage threshold 3.5 dBm per lane (optical table); 5.5 dBm in absolute max ratings table.
